title: Robot wearing a party hat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Party hat -->
  <polygon points='50,6 36,34 64,34' fill='#ff4fa3'/>
  <polygon points='50,6 44,22 50,34' fill='#ffd23f'/>
  <polygon points='50,6 56,22 50,34' fill='#3fd0ff'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='6' r='4' fill='#ffd23f'/>
  <path d='M36 34 Q50 40 64 34' fill='none' stroke='#b02a72' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Pom pom band dots -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='30' r='2' fill='#3fd0ff'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='32' r='2' fill='#ff4fa3'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='30' r='2' fill='#ffd23f'/>
  <!-- Antenna nubs -->
  <rect x='30' y='44' width='5' height='8' rx='2' fill='#9ad0e8'/>
  <rect x='65' y='44' width='5' height='8' rx='2' fill='#9ad0e8'/>
  <!-- Head/body -->
  <rect x='26' y='40' width='48' height='44' rx='10' fill='#7fd3f0'/>
  <rect x='26' y='40' width='48' height='44' rx='10' fill='none' stroke='#b8ecff' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- Screen -->
  <rect x='34' y='48' width='32' height='24' rx='6' fill='#1a2a44'/>
  <rect x='34' y='48' width='32' height='24' rx='6' fill='none' stroke='#5fc9ee' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- Glowing eyes -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='58' r='3' fill='#7dffb0'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='58' r='3' fill='#7dffb0'/>
  <!-- Glowing smile -->
  <path d='M43 65 Q50 70 57 65' fill='none' stroke='#7dffb0' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Cheek lights -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='63' r='1.6' fill='#ff8ad1'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='63' r='1.6' fill='#ff8ad1'/>
  <!-- Arms -->
  <rect x='16' y='56' width='10' height='7' rx='3' fill='#5fb8d8'/>
  <rect x='74' y='56' width='10' height='7' rx='3' fill='#5fb8d8'/>
  <!-- Feet -->
  <rect x='34' y='82' width='12' height='7' rx='3' fill='#5fb8d8'/>
  <rect x='54' y='82' width='12' height='7' rx='3' fill='#5fb8d8'/>
  <!-- Belt -->
  <rect x='26' y='76' width='48' height='5' fill='#4aa6c9'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='78.5' r='3' fill='#ffd23f'/>
</svg>
